tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Everything sits on this unless it is a card, code or a band.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inline code, tag pills, alternating page bands, the note callout.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (post, talk, project) and the theme toggle track. In light it equals surface-subtle; in dark it lifts one step above code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky header fill, always paired with a 20px backdrop blur and saturate(180%). Never for content.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface, surface-subtle, surface-raised and every callout ground (15:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, reading time, descriptions, captions, code comments' neighbours. Text on surface (5.1:1 / 8.2:1) and surface-subtle (4.7:1 / 7.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Icons and placeholder glyphs only, never text: 3.6:1 on surface in light, which clears the 3:1 icon floor but not the 4.5:1 text floor.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers: header bottom edge, list separators, table rules. Carries no meaning, so no contrast floor.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active nav item, inline arrows. Text on surface (5.6:1 / 7.0:1), surface-subtle (5.1:1 / 6.0:1) and surface-raised (5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link and arrow-link hover. Same grounds as accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Only ever under on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent-fill (4.7:1) and accent-fill-hover (5.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, info callout ground, text selection, the active table-of-contents row.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. 4.3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: callout-info-ink
tokens.usage: Info callout icon and label on callout-info-bg.

tokens.name: callout-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info callout ground. Body text on it is ink.

tokens.name: callout-note-ink
tokens.usage: Note callout icon and label on callout-note-bg.

tokens.name: callout-note-bg
tokens.usage: Note callout ground: an aside, deliberately the quietest of the four.

tokens.name: callout-tip-ink
tokens.usage: Tip callout icon and label on callout-tip-bg (4.6:1 / 9.0:1).

tokens.name: callout-tip-bg
tokens.usage: Tip callout ground.

tokens.name: callout-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warn callout icon and label on callout-warn-bg (5.0:1 / 8.6:1). Orange, not red: warn and tip stay apart for red-green colour blindness, and every callout also carries its word and icon.

tokens.name: callout-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warn callout ground.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Fenced code block and inline code ground.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Plain code text and identifiers on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-line-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of lines picked with hl_lines. Full bleed across the block.

tokens.name: code-inserted-bg
tokens.usage: Added lines in diff blocks. Text stays code-ink.

tokens.name: code-deleted-bg
tokens.usage: Removed lines in diff blocks. Text stays code-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (func, package, if, return, let). 6.4:1 / 7.9:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: String and char literals. 4.9:1 / 10.1:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans, nil and other constants. 5.9:1 / 9.3:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Type names, classes, builtins. 6.8:1 / 8.8:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names at definition and call. 5.5:1 / 9.9:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-attribute
tokens.usage: YAML keys, HTML attributes, struct tags, shell variables. 6.3:1 / 10.5:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, set italic. 4.7:1 / 5.6:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-punctuation
tokens.usage: Operators, brackets, punctuation. 8.1:1 / 10.7:1 on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-prompt
tokens.usage: The $ prompt and command output in console blocks, so the typed command reads first.

tokens.name: diagram-ground
tokens.usage: D2 canvas (N7). Diagrams sit directly on the page with no frame.

tokens.name: diagram-container
tokens.usage: D2 container fill (B4, B5 and N6).

tokens.name: diagram-shape
tokens.usage: D2 shape fill (B6, AA5, AB5).

tokens.name: diagram-stroke
tokens.usage: D2 shape outlines and connections (B1, B3, N3, N4, N5). 3.3:1 on diagram-container in light, the floor for marks that carry meaning.

tokens.name: diagram-text
tokens.usage: D2 labels inside shapes (N1).

tokens.name: diagram-label
tokens.usage: D2 connection labels and container titles in secondary weight (N2).

tokens.name: diagram-accent
tokens.usage: D2 highlighted path or shape stroke (B2, AA2). Use for at most one path per diagram.

tokens.name: diagram-accent-fill
tokens.usage: D2 highlighted shape fill (AA4, AB4).

families.sans: "Inter Variable", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero name only. Drops to title-1 below 640px.

styles.name: title-1
styles.sample: The unreasonable effectiveness of VEX in NixOS
styles.usage: Article title and page titles (Posts, Talks, Projects). 32px/38px below 640px.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Article h2 and home section headings.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Post list titles, project card names, article h4.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: We explore why NixOS is uniquely positioned to implement a scalable process for vulnerability management.
styles.usage: Article description under the title, home intro. In ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Triggered by the flood of LLM-assisted vulnerability reports this year, we have heard a lot about the struggles that maintainers face.
styles.usage: Article prose. Max line length is the measure token (680px, about 72 characters).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Post-Quantum Cryptography is no longer theoretical.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, callout body, table cells, footer.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, reading time, figure captions, venue lines. In ink-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a card title (venue, series name). The only uppercase in the system.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside any text style; scales with its parent.

styles.name: code-label
styles.usage: Code block filename or language label, the copy button's tooltip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags, between eyebrow and title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (with space-4 for large), list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, callout padding, code block padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing in prose.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above an h2 in prose; between figure and text.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop; top of the article header.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Home hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Prose column width: paragraphs, lists, callouts, inline headings.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Breakout width for wide code blocks, D2 diagrams and cover images; also the header and card grid width.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header height. Scroll-margin-top for anchored headings.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Copy button, small icon buttons, table wrapper.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, callouts, D2 shapes (border-radius 10 in D2 units at 0.85 scale).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and card images.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Article cover image, home portrait frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tag pills, theme toggle.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare: surfaces separate by fill, not elevation. Only interactive cards lift on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Card hover lift, together with translateY(-2px).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The 'Copied' toast on code blocks.
